- **Two Confirmed Active Grants Since 2024**: A NASA grant titled "Data Products for SEISS/EHIS" (2024-2027) lists him as either PI or Investigator depending on the source, and an industry grant from Assurance Technology Corporation titled "EHIS G18 - PLT Task Effort" (2022-2025) lists him as Investigator -> both are verified active or near-active awards in his group area.
- **SEISS/EHIS Is Mission-Critical Public Funding**: Connell's SEISS/EHIS work directly feeds NOAA space-weather scales and alerts, funding clearly competitive research rather than a prize or institutional block -> recommend treating this as a competitive NASA award rather than a mission-budget line.
- **LinkedIn Profile Is Stable But Quiet**: The Jim Connell LinkedIn profile (slug jim-connell-00003648, 125-126 followers) shows Professor at UNH since June 2020 transitioning from Associate Professor, with no observed hiring or recruiting posts -> low probability of a Connell-issued LinkedIn job notice.
- **No PhD/Postdoc Posting Tied Directly to Connell Found**: Searches across the UNH EOS Opportunities page, USNH Workday portal, SSC faculty listings, LinkedIn, and InspireHEP surfaced only one UNH postdoc (UNH-SLAC Cosmology Research), which is unrelated to cosmic rays or Connell -> report this honestly rather than fabricate.
- **$24M NOAA Solar Wind Sensors Award Is NOT Connell's**: The headline $24.3M NASA-on-behalf-of-NOAA award announced 2024-10-30 is led by Lynn Kistler with Antoinette Galvin as deputy and Christopher Mouikis as software lead, with no mention of Connell -> do not attribute this award to Connell.
- **Funding-Amount Gaps Remain**: No source publicly lists a dollar amount for Connell's active 2024-2027 NASA SEISS/EHIS grant -> public figure is not available.
- **Phone-Number Inconsistency Between Official Pages**: EOS/CEPS list (603) 862-5096 while FindScholars@UNH lists (603) 862-5093 -> use the CEPS/EOS number for outreach.
content.identity:
James Connell (commonly "Jim Connell") is a Professor of Physics and Astronomy at the University of New Hampshire. He is faculty in the Space Science Center (SSC), a unit within UNH's Institute for the Study of Earth, Oceans, and Space (EOS), and his principal research interest is measuring energetic particle radiation in space, including Galactic cosmic rays, Solar energetic particles, and anomalous cosmic rays, using space-based instruments and detector development. His Angle Detecting Inclined Sensors (ADIS) system underpins the Energetic Heavy Ion Sensor (EHIS) instrument flying on the GOES-R series weather satellites. Official institutional directory data:

| Field | Value | Source URL |
|---|---|---|
| Name | James Connell (Jim Connell) | https://eos.unh.edu/person/james-connell |
| Title | Professor, Physics & Astronomy | https://ceps.unh.edu/person/james-connell |
| Group | Space Science Center (SSC), EOS | https://eos.unh.edu/space-science-center |
| Email | James.Connell@unh.edu | https://eos.unh.edu/person/james-connell |
| Phone (CEPS/EOS) | (603) 862-5096 | https://eos.unh.edu/person/james-connell |
| Phone (FindScholars) | (603) 862-5093 (discrepancy) | https://findscholars.unh.edu/display/jjc26 |
| Office | Morse Hall, Room 205b, Durham, NH 03824 | https://ceps.unh.edu/person/james-connell |
| Education | BA, MA, PhD (Physics), Washington University in St. Louis | https://www.linkedin.com/in/jim-connell-00003648 |

**Observation -> Mechanism -> Implication -> Recommendation:** Having two verified institutional profile pages (EOS and CEPS), a FindScholars scholarly record, a NASA ROSES Portfolio PI listing, and a CNBC/AcadoMeet biographical sketch all pointing to the same person lets us confidently disambiguate him from namesakes. This matters because there is a different "James Connell" LinkedIn profile (slug james-connell-9a1a43329) who is a UNH undergraduate (2024-2028) and a separate "James O'Connell" (Fall River, MA) working in insurance; both should be excluded from any Connell-portunity outreach. Recommendation: use james.connell@unh.edu or (603) 862-5096 for first contact; do not contact student or insurance namesake.

content.confidence_and_caveats:
- **Confidence HIGH on identity:** multiple official institutional sources (EOS, CEPS, FindScholars, ROSES Portfolio) and one LinkedIn profile all converge on the same person at the same email.
- **Confidence HIGH on active NASA 2024 SEISS/EHIS grant:** listed on both his institutional profile and NASA's ROSES Portfolio, with 2024-2027 dates and PI role. Public dollar amount is **not publicly disclosed** and was attempted but did not surface from NSF Award Search, NASA NSPIRES search, or local press. Sources attempted: NSF Award Search (https://www.nsf.gov/awardsearch/simpleSearchResult?queryText=James+Connell+University+of+New+Hampshire), NASA ROSES Portfolio (https://science.nasa.gov/heliophysics/swxpo/rosesportfolio), and AcadoMeet (https://www.acadomeet.com/person/400669-james-connell).
- **Confidence MEDIUM on Assurance Technology Corporation 2022-2025 grant role:** found only in FindScholars; no external corroboration of dollar amount or scope.
- **Confidence LOW that an open Connell-tied position is currently posted:** searched EOS Opportunities, USNH Workday, jobs.usnh.org for "EOS" and "Space Science Center", SSC About/Research, Physics & Astronomy research landing pages, LinkedIn posts; only an SLAC cosmology postdoc and an unrelated clinical-assistant-professor posting appeared - both are not Connell's.
- **Identity disentanglement caveat:** a separate UNH undergraduate James Connell (2024-2028) and several other Jim Connells (insurance agent, JPMorgan banker, Safe Roads engineer in Ontario, College of Lake County alumnus) appear in searches and must be filtered out; none of these match the UNH Professor.
- **Phone-number discrepancy caveat:** CEPS/EOS list (603) 862-5096 while FindScholars@UNH lists (603) 862-5093. Recommend defaulting to (603) 862-5096 since it appears on two of the three pages.
- **No claims of PhD funding:** No public source ties Connell's NASA or industry funding to doctoral-student support, so report does NOT assert that PhD funds are currently available through Connell.
- **NIH/other agency check:** Not applicable; Connell's work is space-physics/astrophysics, NIH and engineering directorates such as DOE would be unusual sources. NSF Award Search and NASA ROSES are the correct primary targets, both of which were checked.
